models.composition: Pietà — Model for the Martius Mausoleum
models.qualification: Photogrammetry published by kulturschokolade.org (3dtwins), tagged RealityCapture and optimized for real-time viewing. Largest thumbnail inspected: the two adult figures, exposed torso and legs of Christ, hands, feet and base are present with detailed surface color. The scan matches the museum photograph and the specific B553 brown-yellow plaster material description; this physical identity is a visual/source cross-match because the publisher does not name the museum. About 10,081 faces, so native review must inspect silhouette simplification, fingers, upper heads, reverse and underside. Museum-documented 2019 finger restoration belongs to the physical object; no digital reconstruction is asserted.
